test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

“I don't feel like hanging out today. I'm feeling a bit __unwell__.”
solution: The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **“under the weather”** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Unwell: **means poor health. • **Under the Weather: **Feeling unwell or in poor health. (अस्वस्थ या खराब स्वास्थ्य महसूस करना) • Hence, “under the weather” is the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. Therefore, the complete sentence is ***“**I don't feel like hanging out today. I'm feeling a bit under the weather__.”* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Under the Coat: **Hidden or secret, not openly acknowledged. (छिपा हुआ या गुप्त, खुले तौर पर स्वीकार नहीं किया गया) • **Over the Moon:** Extremely happy or delighted. (अत्यधिक प्रसन्न या प्रसन्न होना) • **Near the Horizon: **Imminent or likely to happen soon. (आसन्न या जल्द ही घटित होने की संभावना) 54:T861, The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **'discussing'.**
